name: RTC Nightmare Engine
description: Ported from RTCV's real RTC_NightmareEngine.GenerateUnit. Random: every blast writes a brand-new random value. RandomTilt: each blast randomly writes a new value, adds 1, or subtracts 1 from what's already there. Tilt: each blast randomly adds 1 or subtracts 1. The address alignment math (safeAddress + its out-of-range clamp) is copied directly from RTCV's source, and is genuinely different from the Vector Engine's own clamp formula.
author: Ported from RTCV (RTC_NightmareEngine.cs) for RTCFS4A

parameters.label: Algorithm
parameters.description: Random: always writes a new value. RandomTilt: new value, +1, or -1, chosen randomly each blast. Tilt: +1 or -1, chosen randomly each blast.

parameters.label: Min Value (64-bit)
parameters.description: Very large 64-bit bounds may lose a little precision if you edit them by hand (the input box can't represent every one of the ~1.8x10^19 possible values exactly) — the default full range is exact until you touch it.

parameters.label: Max Value (64-bit)
parameters.description: Same precision caveat as Min Value (64-bit) above.

parameters.label: Blast Count
parameters.description: How many random operations to perform. Use the number box next to the slider for exact values.

parameters.label: Alignment
parameters.description: Sub-offset added after rounding down to Precision: safeAddress = address - (address % precision) + alignment.

parameters.label: Header Size
parameters.description: Bytes to leave alone at the start of the file when Start Byte is -1. 16 for .nes/.fds, 512 for headered .smc, 0 for a headerless ROM.

parameters.label: Big Endian
parameters.description: Byte order for multi-byte writes and tilts.

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.description: -1 = random (a fresh seed every run, still recorded into this field on Save so Export Config can reproduce it later). Any value 0 or above is used as a fixed seed instead.
